app.title: MundaSense AI
app.tagline: Ziva njodzi. Nzwisisa chikonzero. Tora danho goho risati rasvika.
demo.banner: Modhi yekuratidzira: yakadzidziswa nedata rakagadzirwa chete. Mhedzisiro ndeyekuratidzira uye haisati yasimbiswa muminda.
demo.shona_review: Mashoko eShona ndeekuratidzira uye anoda kuongororwa nenyanzvi yeShona neyekurima asati ashandiswa mumunda.
result.referral_body: Mhedzisiro iyi inofanira kuongororwa nemurimisi wezvekurima nekuti njodzi, kuvimba, kana yambiro yedata yapfuura muganhu wekuchengeteka wekuratidzira.
result.disclaimer: Rubatsiro rwekuita sarudzo chete. Fungidziro iyi haisi vimbiso uye haitore nzvimbo yekuongorora munda kana zano renyanzvi.
driver.increased: Modhi yakabatanidza kukosha uku nefungidziro yakakwira pane chiyero chekuratidzira.
driver.decreased: Modhi yakabatanidza kukosha uku nefungidziro yakaderera pane chiyero chekuratidzira.
driver.neutral: Kukosha uku hakuna kushandura zvakanyanya fungidziro kana kuchienzaniswa nechiyero chekuratidzira.
warning.unusual: {feature} iri kunze kwemuganhu wakajairika wemodhi ({lower} kusvika {upper}). Kuvimba kwaderedzwa.
warning.extreme: {feature} iri kunze kwezvakamboonekwa mudata rakagadzirwa rekudzidzisa. Simbisai kuyerwa musati mavimba nemhedzisiro.
warning.multiple: Zvinhu zvakawanda hazvina kujairika kumodhi iyi. Shandisai mhedzisiro nokungwarira uye kumbirai kuongororwa nenyanzvi.
advice.verify.title: Simbisai kuyerwa kusina kujairika
advice.verify.body: Ongororai zvakare kuyerwa kwakanyorwa, mayuniti, uye nguva yeongororo musati maita sarudzo yepurazi.
advice.high_risk.title: Rongai kuongororwa nenyanzvi
advice.high_risk.body: Ongororai mamiriro emunda, danho rechirimwa, uye zvinyorwa zvichangobva kuitwa nemurimisi wezvekurima musati machinja manejimendi.
advice.low_confidence.title: Shandisai humbowo hwemunda musati maita danho
advice.low_confidence.body: Humbowo hwemodhi hahuna kusimba panyaya iyi. Ongororai munda uye tsvagai rubatsiro rwenyanzvi.
advice.water_stress.title: Ongororai kushomeka kwemvura nekuyerera kwayo
advice.water_stress.body: Ongororai chirimwa nevhu kuti muone kushomeka kwemvura kana matambudziko ekuyerera, uye teverai mamiriro ekunze nemunda nguva nenguva.
advice.soil_test.title: Simbisai mamiriro evhu
advice.soil_test.body: Fungai nezvekuongorora ivhu kwakakodzera munharaunda uye kurukurai mhedzisiro nenyanzvi musati machinja zano rezvekudya kwezvirimwa.
advice.monitor.title: Rambai muchiongorora munda zvakarongeka
advice.monitor.body: Chengetai zvinyorwa zvemvura, mamiriro echirimwa, nezvamakashandisa kuitira kuti shanduko dziongororwe nekukurumidza.
